findings.title: Operation report: what was done
findings.detail: Right lateral decubitus, Southern Moore approach with a 15 cm curved incision. Fractured femoral head extracted; 28 mm head chosen; 40 mm cement stopper and a cemented femoral stem size 8 in about 15 degrees of anteversion. Drain placed. Above knee compression and knee immobilizer applied; shifted out with stable vitals. Counts verified. Approximate blood loss 200 ml.
findings.verbatim: a head size of 28mm was chosen. Broaching was done on femur serially from small to larger size (till 9 size) keeping anteversion ~15 degree. Trial implants were placed; head reduced and hip range of movements assessed. Cement stopper (40mm) was inserted in the femoral canal. A cemented femoral stem (size 8) inserted in approximately 15 degrees of anteversion. Irrigation done, hemostasis achieved and drain placed. Capsular layer sutured with vicryl no.1, short external rotators sutured through transosseously with GT. Deep fascia closed with Stratafix and subcutaneus closure done with Vicryl 1-0. Skin closed with stratafix. Above knee compression & knee immobilizer were applied and patient shifted out with stable vitals

lines.label: Steps of Surgery (page 2)
lines.text: a head size of 28mm was chosen. Broaching was done on femur serially from small to larger size (till 9 size) keeping anteversion ~15 degree. Trial implants were placed; head reduced and hip range of movements assessed. Cement stopper (40mm) was inserted in the femoral canal. A cemented femoral stem (size 8) inserted in approximately 15 degrees of anteversion. Irrigation done, hemostasis achieved and drain placed. Capsular layer sutured with vicryl no.1, short external rotators sutured through transosseously with GT. Deep fascia closed with Stratafix and subcutaneus closure done with Vicryl 1-0. Skin closed with stratafix. Above knee compression & knee immobilizer were applied and patient shifted out with stable vitals

exceptions.body: The consent's procedure line says 'Right NOF fracture', while its own next paragraph and every other page say left.

exceptions.title: Date of the fall
exceptions.body: The discharge summary, the orthopaedic case record and the IP assessment form give 05/11/26 (11 am). The pre-anaesthetic record writes 6/11/26, which is after the admission date.

exceptions.title: Telmisartan 40 mg: taken at home, missing afterwards
exceptions.body: General medicine and anaesthesia list Telma (telmisartan) 40 mg 1-0-1 as a current medicine. It is not on any in-hospital order sheet and not on the discharge list, and no page says it was stopped.

exceptions.title: Sodium and potassium on 5 Nov copied differently
exceptions.body: The investigation chart has Na 137 and K 3.5. The orthopaedic progress sheet and the pre-anaesthetic record have Na 136 and K 3.6. No printed report is in this PDF to settle it.

exceptions.title: Chest X-ray read two ways
exceptions.body: General medicine describes left sided homogenous opacification of the lung field. Pulmonology writes 'rotated film, cannot comment'. No radiology report is in the file.

exceptions.title: Acute bronchitis: current or past
exceptions.body: The discharge summary lists acute bronchitis in the final diagnosis. The medicine and pulmonology notes date it to May 2026, and the pre-anaesthetic record mentions a recent chest infection with fever 2 weeks earlier, symptom free for 1 week.

exceptions.title: Temperature on arrival
exceptions.body: The orthopaedic examination sheet has 38 written in the printed 'Temp ... °C' field. The nurses' transfer summary the same evening records 98.6°F, and the patient is called afebrile on the pre-anaesthetic record.

exceptions.title: Skin closure and surgery times in the operative records
exceptions.body: The steps of surgery say the skin was closed with stratafix, the wound closure table says staples. The operation report times surgery 14:00 to 16:00; the anaesthetic record writes about 1:45 pm to 4:25 pm, and has a mark on the General box although the technique written is spinal with nerve blocks.

exceptions.title: One pre-operative injection could not be read
exceptions.body: The last line of the pre-operative orders, in a different hand, is an injection of 1 g IV marked '2'. The name reads like 'Vanking' but is not certain, and it is not on the anaesthetic record or the operation report. It is held back from the medicine list.

exceptions.title: Hard handwriting on three consultation pages
exceptions.body: The undated pulmonology review (10 Nov), the ophthalmology visual acuity line, and the urea, creatinine and pre-operative sugar limit in the general medicine note were only partly readable. Values taken from them carry low confidence.

exceptions.title: Frequency missing for Evion on the discharge list
exceptions.body: The frequency cell for Evion 400 is blank on the typed discharge list. The in-hospital orders gave it 0-1-0.
